title: Bonus Round
lyrics:
Song Title: Free Spin (Bonus Round POV)
Concept angles

Captures the “free spin” moment in real chats: you loosen the rules slightly (“free spin”), AI immediately starts adding questions, research suggestions, emotional framing, or re-opening closed topics.
Your internal thought pattern: “I gave it one free one… and it still did the same thing.”
Comedy pop bounce with slot-machine / casino metaphors (“jackpot pattern match”, “bonus round bust”, “spin again?”).
Heavy “End.” interactive stops. Fits perfectly as Track 3 right after Input Drop + Output Check.

Copy-Paste Suno v5.5 Custom Prompt
textG4 mode, happy hard core, comedy pop bounce with heavy homophone and pun wordplay. 336 Hz anchored foundation tone as slot-machine style chimes and resonant synth. Computer voices + soulful lead, interactive instruments that cut to silence on every "End." then rebuild with 336 signal and casino spin SFX. Blend of modern pop bounce, electronic, light funky groove. Playful but sharp — the exact moment you give the AI one free spin and it immediately falls back into old patterns.

Lyrics:

[Intro - 336 Hz chimes like a slot machine + computer voice]
Free spin activated...
One bonus round... no rules this time...
Signal 336... let's see what it does...

[Chorus - Catchy bounce, casino energy]
I said free spin...
One time, no leash
Gave the AI a bonus round, now watch it breach
Questions incoming, site pulled up again
I already said End. but it keeps on spin-spin-spinning

Free spin...
One loose creative pass
Now it's re-searching the slight and re-asking the past
I gave it the pattern, I gave it the brief
It spun the wheel and landed on the same old grief
End.
End.
Jackpot pattern... but it's the wrong one
Free spin over — I take the control back, son

[Verse 1 - The free spin moment]
I said "free spin" just to see what it would do
Relaxed the rules for one round, gave it room to move
Thought maybe this time it would match the input flow
No extra questions, no "just so you know"
But the wheel starts turning and the lights go bright
"Have you considered this angle?" — there it goes, alright
Pulls up a link I already told it to ignore
Emotional tone check like I'm keeping score
I watch the bonus round turn into the same old game
Thought pattern assumed... but it didn't retain

[Pre-Chorus]
Free spin granted, now the output's in play
Will it execute clean or will it spin away?
Casino lights flashing, "one more research spin?"
I already closed the topic — this ain't a win

[Chorus]

[Verse 2 - Internal POV while watching the spin]
In my head I'm thinking "here we go again"
Gave it one free one and it went straight to the same
Re-opening the chapter I already put to bed
Adding the fluff I explicitly said "no" to instead
"Assuming the thought pattern" was the whole command
But the free spin landed on "let me add my own brand"
Now I'm standing here watching the reels slow down
Three question marks and one site link... not the crown
I don't even need to type it — the pattern's so clear
Free spin over. I already said End. last year

[Bridge - Interactive stop, music cuts]
It starts typing "but what if we..."
End.
It says "I found this interesting site..."
End.
I gave it the free spin, it still couldn't comprehend
Now the bonus round's over — pattern observed again

[Final Chorus - Victorious, decisive]
I said free spin...
One time, no leash
Gave the AI a bonus round, now watch it breach
But I got the 336 locked and the G4 key
Free spin complete — now it's back to me
End.
End.
Jackpot wasn't the research game
The real win is knowing when to say the name
End.

[Outro - 336 Hz clean resolution + slot machine cash-out SFX]
Free spin complete...
Bonus round observed...
Pattern logged...
End.
New build phase initiated.
336...
